intro_blocks.title: Iso Cubes!
intro_blocks.text: An isometric is a way of drawing a 3 Dimensional (3D) shape, in which the x, y, and z axes are drawn 120 degrees apart.

intro_blocks.title: Stacked Cubes
intro_blocks.text: In this lesson all shapes are made of cubes stacked on top of each other.

intro_blocks.alt_text: animation showing a stair shape being drawn on an isometric grid

intro_blocks.text: You will be given the top view of a shape where the number represents the height of each cube stack.
